title: Safe number parsing
description:
Turn errors into return values and back.

```
parse_age("42")    -> 42
parse_age("old")   -> nil, "not a number: old"
parse_age("-1")    -> nil, "age cannot be negative"
safe(parse_or_error, "x") -> false, "not a number: x"
```

starter.main.lua:
local function parse_age(text)
  return tonumber(text)
end

print(parse_age("42"))
print(parse_age("old"))

hints: Return `nil, "not a number: " .. text` for the error case: the caller gets two values (lesson 6.01).
`error({ code = 1, msg = "..." })` can raise a table; `pcall` returns it as the second value.
requirements: `parse_age(text)` returns the number or `nil` and a message.
Show `pcall` turning the error back into `false, message`, and `assert` turning `nil, msg` into an error.
stretch: Use `xpcall` with `debug.traceback` to print where an error came from.
